headline: India's Foreign Exchange Reserves Fall by $5 Billion to $721 Billion
summary: India's forex reserves dropped by $5.011 billion to $721.016 billion in the week ended October 16, according to data from the Reserve Bank of India.
why: Foreign exchange reserves indicate a central bank's capacity to defend its currency and manage foreign debt obligations.

impacts.name: Indian Rupee
impacts.why: Reserve drawdowns often reflect central bank currency defense to counteract import bill and outflow pressures.
